scope: Public GitHub Release distribution of the masters-otb-r3 indexed package and filtered PGN.
recorded_conflicts: The snapshot's RELEASE/DATASET_LICENSE.txt states local internal evaluation only, says not to redistribute the package, and says not to provide raw PGN to end users.
The publisher's B2B terms, as recorded in PUBLISHER_TERMS_REVIEW.json, prohibit end-user bulk exports and direct raw-PGN downloads to end users.
The snapshot's RELEASE.json records public_release_eligible: false and rights_clearance: unresolved_upstream_rights; the publisher supplied no archive checksum.
corpus/catalog.json allows only CC-BY-SA-4.0 for masters-otb; the Gigabase CC BY-NC 4.0 claim is outside the approved catalog.
